measurement: close before print to close after first full session following

names.notes: Reported Q4 FY2026 after close 2026-08-27: GAAP EPS $4.62 vs ~$0.33-0.35 consensus, but almost entirely a $1.45B one-time tax valuation-allowance release, not operating strength (adj. operating margin 30% is the cleaner read). Revenue $1,165.96M vs ~$1,128.5M consensus, beat. Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to $1.19-1.22B. Shares gapped up 11% at the open, ran as high as +16.7%, then gave back nearly the entire move to close +0.35% -- a violent intraday round trip that a close-to-close number completely hides. The Neutral / No Edge call scores a hit under the below-expected-move convention (0.35% << 10.8% unsigned expected) but the realised move landed below even the low end of its own 5.4-22.9% band -- the panel was directionally safe but its magnitude sizing was far too generous on a name that round-tripped back to flat. The red-team's specific reversal case (a credit-provision-driven miss like Feb 2026's -14.47%) did not fire; delinquency/provision detail was not the story here. The stage-2 preliminary read (-18, bearish) called the wrong direction, though the actual move was close enough to zero that 'wrong sign' overstates how wrong it was.

Reported Q1 FY2027 after close 2026-08-27: adjusted EPS $0.70 vs $0.58 consensus (beat), revenue $478.1M vs ~$469.7M consensus (beat, +15% y/y). FY2027 revenue and EPS guidance both raised above prior Street consensus. Shares gapped up 24% at the open, ran to +29% intraday, then faded to close +19.31% -- still a very large move, breaking the 13.4% unsigned expected move by nearly 1.5x. The Neutral / No Edge call is a clean miss under the below-expected-move convention, the same 'stock moved hard and the panel had no view' pattern as OKTA on 2026-08-26, and this was the High-certainty tier's second miss in three tries. The red-team's specific reversal case -- a repeat of May 2026's beat-but-fall-on-soft-FY27-guide trap -- did not fire; guidance was raised, not cautious, and the bear thesis was wrong on its own terms. The stage-2 preliminary read (-20, bearish) also called the wrong direction on this name, breaking a run in which the preliminary read had gone 3-for-3 against a hedging panel.

Reported Q2 FY2027 after close 2026-08-27: adjusted EPS $0.08 vs $0.07 consensus (beat), revenue $292M (beat, +20.6% y/y), ARR $1,218M (+22% y/y). Q3 revenue guide raised modestly but FY adjusted EPS guide of $0.30-0.32 fell short of the $0.35 consensus. Shares gapped down ~5.4% at the open, fell further intraday, then partially recovered to close -5.15%. The stage-2 preliminary read (-15, bearish) called the direction correctly.

Reported Q2 FY2027 after close 2026-08-27: record revenue $2.74B (beat), non-GAAP EPS $0.94 (beat), data-center revenue +46% y/y. Q3 guide and both FY2027/FY2028 outlooks raised -- a clean beat-and-raise on paper. Shares still sold off, gapping down 6.7% and drifting to a low close of -10.28%, attributed to elevated expectations after a ~185% YTD run rather than anything wrong in the print itself. The stage-2 preliminary read (-15, bearish) called the direction correctly despite the fundamentally strong print -- a reminder that 'beat and raise' does not by itself pin the sign of the reaction.

Reported Q2 FY2027 after close 2026-08-27 (an all-time-high close that day): non-GAAP EPS $0.22 vs -$0.04 consensus (large beat), revenue $427.3M vs ~$396.3M consensus (beat, +38% y/y), subscription ARR +33% y/y, FY2027 guidance raised across the board. Shares gapped down 7.5% at the open, spiked intraday to briefly exceed the prior close, then collapsed to close -13.06% near the day's low -- the most dramatic intraday reversal of the five names this run. The stage-2 preliminary read (-10, bearish) called the direction correctly on a name whose valuation, not its fundamentals, appears to have driven the reaction.
